lines.l: And when you just feel out of reach, I'll give you the hope you need
Let me be the one who guides you back home
Just hold me and never let go
I promise I'll cherish your body and soul
You can count on me
And I will be the only thing you'll see
And I will be the only air you breathe
And I'll be the one to call and sing, sing, sing
Don't worry about the space and time
I'll be holding you so tight
I'll keep you warm when your heart gets cold
I'll take your struggles every fight
And turn the all into light
I'll bring you back to where you belong
You can count on me
And I'ma be the only thing you'll see
And I'ma be the only air you breathe
And I'ma be the one to come and see
You can count on me
And I'ma be the only thing you'll see
And I'ma be the only air you breathe
